crossRefs.note: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated…
From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long; for it was twenty years; and all the house of…
They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

parallels.note: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

people.name: Abinadab
people.line: Kept the ark of God in his house

people.name: Ahio
people.line: Son of Abinadab, accompanied the ark from Kiriath-jearim

translations.web: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house, which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.
translations.bsb: bringing with it the ark of God. And Ahio was walking in front of the ark.
translations.kjv: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
translations.asv: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was in the hill, with the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
